summary: Successfully completed comprehensive testing of QuickMenuJA merchant section functionality. All core merchant features working perfectly including login, menu management, and item creation via both API and UI.

minor_issues.issue: JSON parsing errors in backend tests for CSS/JS assets, but files load correctly with 200 status
minor_issues.impact: No functional impact - assets work correctly in browser
